decision.rationale: The UBC-branded Time and Place project is a public teaching and learning resource on UBC histories and relations, with educator guidance, a timeline, project announcements and developer narratives. Its homepage discusses UBC on Musqueam territory, not an exclusively Okanagan service. A student assistant and developer stories are parts of the institutional TLEF-funded project rather than evidence of a personal/student-run site. Academic resources are the default, with observed stories, dated project news and contact support routed separately. No matching published host or observed historical alias was found.

rules.rationale: The homepage explicitly presents Developer’s Stories as narrative reflections distinct from the educational timeline.
The homepage presents project-grant and team-update announcements under dated post paths.
The observed Contact Us section provides a way to ask questions and suggest project improvements.
The timeline, educator guide, and faculty resources are explicitly offered for teaching and learning.

fallback.rationale: The institutional project provides a starting point for learning and discussions about multilayered histories at UBC.
